title: WATCH: Nursing licensure exam passers, loved ones cry tears of joy after learning results
summary: Students who passed the recent nursing exams were able to have sweet moments with their families as they celebrated their achievements.

blocks.text: Students who passed the recent nursing exams were able to have sweet moments with their families as they celebrated their achievements.
According to a report on "24 Oras," Youscooper Heaven waited for the results with her family and subsequently yelled with joy with them after seeing that she passed.
Meanwhile, Youscooper Francis celebrated with his grandmother, who then had lechon prepared for his achievement.
Then there was Youscooper Valrexie, who was in tears as she shared the results with her migrant worker brother.
Valrexie and her brother no longer have parents, so the latter had to work for the former’s studies.
The Professional Regulation Commission (PRC) said that 28,652 out of 37,359 takers were able to pass. –Jean Mangaluz/NB, GMA News
